_meta.description: Measured fixture geometry. footprint=[w,l] and height are the geom-AABB world extents; offset=[dx,dy] is the geom-AABB CENTER relative to the fixture body position (the value the renderer emits as <fixture>.position) — required because irregular fixtures (flat_stove) have collision geometry offset ~100 mm from their body origin, so an origin-centered clearance box misses part of the real fixture and a table distractor is injected penetrating it (RCA robot_distractor_settle.md). Missing offset defaults to [0,0]. top_z is the REST surface height above TABLE_Z (the distractor↔fixture contact surface, NOT max geom z). Generated by scripts/measure_spawn_clearances.py (measure_distractor_fixtures) + scripts/measure_fixture_offsets.py. settle_top_z (open-frame fixtures only) is the settle-measured height a FLAT distractor actually rests at on the fixture top — below top_z for open frames (rails) — used for the rule-2 analytic on-fixture DISTRACTOR z; absent ⇒ falls back to top_z. Generated by scripts/measure_spawn_clearances.py --distractor-settle-z.
